source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
observations: Matrix entries 1e-13 and 1e-20 survive multiplication by 1, determinant, inverse and rescaling. A 2x2 diagonal 1e-20 matrix has determinant 1e-40 and inverse diagonal 1e20.
Matrix [1,1;1,1.0000000000001] has determinant 1e-13 and an inverse; PLUS does not snap the small pivot to zero.
Vectors (3e-20,4e-20) and (3e20,4e20) normalize to (0.6,0.8). Tiny dot product is 2.5e-39.
Line input inserts literal ×10^( or ^(. RIGHT at the end does not close the exponent; a real closing parenthesis is needed before addition outside it.
Det(MatA)-1e12 preserves 0.1 after entering 1e12+0.1 with a closed exponent. Without closing, the input is 10^(12+0.1) instead. All recorded frames are named to reflect actual input.
Array scalar results wrap after 17 linear cells (187 pixels). Missing trailing parentheses are accepted without adding them to the displayed expression.
VctA raised to 2 reports Math ERROR; Back retains VctA^(2 and the cursor.
